second_read.note: Journal = arXiv v3 to every digit. Eq. (13)/(15): H in Hartree with Ewald sum and a background constant; simple cubic simulation cell with PBC, plane waves k = 2πn/L (Gamma). Convention: the paper's quoted BF-DMC column equals arXiv:0801.0518's Ha values with Madelung (e.g. 0.52989(4) at rs = 1), and the MP-NQS energies sit below QMBL's HF (1.065452 Ha/e) by plausible correlation energies. VMC with the paper's own MP-NQS -> variational; how the final energy and its bar were estimated (final-state evaluation vs averaged training iterations) is not stated (C6/C7). Fully polarized (Tables IV/V captions), N_dn = 0.
